promoBanner.label: Announcement
promoBanner.useWhen: There is a current, useful announcement.
promoBanner.inputs: Approved message, destination, and an expiry/review owner.

stickyCallBar.label: Mobile contact
stickyCallBar.useWhen: Phone visitors need immediate contact access.
stickyCallBar.inputs: Real phone; confirmed SMS support; a message destination.

stats.label: Business statistics
stats.inputs: Source, date, and owner for each number.

credentials.label: Credentials
credentials.useWhen: Qualifications matter to choosing this contractor.
credentials.inputs: Actual credentials, scope, jurisdiction, insurance wording.

beforeAfter.label: Before and after
beforeAfter.useWhen: Matched images explain a meaningful transformation.
beforeAfter.inputs: Real paired photos, same job, permission, accurate captions.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.useWhen: A visual collection adds evidence beyond case studies.
gallery.inputs: Permissioned job photos, service tags, meaningful descriptions.

projects.label: Project stories
projects.useWhen: Customers need evidence of comparable completed work.
projects.inputs: Actual job, location at appropriate privacy level, scope, decisions, finish, photos.

blog.label: Field guides
blog.useWhen: Real customer questions merit maintained guidance.
blog.inputs: Service relationship, author/reviewer, sources, actual publish/update dates.

about.label: About
about.useWhen: Visitors need to know who will do the work.
about.inputs: Approved business history, owner introduction, working practices.

team.label: Crew
team.useWhen: Identifying crew members helps the customer relationship.
team.inputs: Names, roles, permissioned photos and biographies.

serviceArea.label: Service area
serviceArea.useWhen: Visitors need to know whether their property is covered.
serviceArea.inputs: Confirmed business base, town/state/county records, service boundaries.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.useWhen: The business can responsibly explain costs or ranges.
pricing.inputs: Approved cost factors or ranges, assumptions, exclusions, review date.

financing.label: Payment options
financing.useWhen: A real payment or financing arrangement is offered.
financing.inputs: Provider and applicable terms, eligibility, disclosures, accurate destination.

warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.useWhen: A defined workmanship commitment is offered.

careers.label: Careers
careers.inputs: Real role, requirements, current availability, application contact.

equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.useWhen: Equipment capabilities help establish fit for a job.
equipment.inputs: Actual equipment and its customer-relevant capability.

emergency.label: Urgent help
emergency.inputs: Supported situations, hours, real emergency number, response expectations.

reviewsPage.label: Reviews
reviewsPage.inputs: Exact quotes, attribution, source links and publication dates.

faqPage.label: FAQ
faqPage.useWhen: Questions need a browsable home beyond service pages.
faqPage.inputs: Accurate answers, service scope, reviewed technical guidance.

contactPage.label: Contact
contactPage.useWhen: Visitors need a clear contact destination.
contactPage.inputs: Real contact methods, supported SMS, hours and response expectations.

estimateWizard.label: Estimate builder
estimateWizard.useWhen: Projects benefit from guided context gathering.
estimateWizard.inputs: Service prompts, clear local-draft wording, verified device handoffs.

search.label: Search
search.useWhen: The selected site has enough content to benefit from search.
search.inputs: Useful titles, summaries, relationships and customer vocabulary.

legal.label: Policies
legal.useWhen: The site needs accurate policies and accessibility information.
legal.inputs: Actual hosting, storage, integrations, business terms, support channel.
